cover: Drones behind most child casualties: UNICEF
Father and son among eight killed
Woman loses leg in third blast in days

stories.label: World · Life & safety
stories.head: Drones over Sudan's children
bullets: UNICEF: two in three child casualties this year came from armed drones.
Up to 15 power stations were hit in October.
UNICEF could not say who launched the strikes.

stories.label: World · Life & safety
stories.head: Eight killed in a day in Gaza
bullets: A 13-year-old boy and his father were among them, health sources said.
Over 1,600 killed since the truce, the health ministry says.
No Israeli military comment was reported.

stories.label: India · Life & safety
stories.head: A blast in a cattle field
bullets: A 41-year-old woman lost her left leg while grazing cattle.
Villagers say it was the third blast in about five days.

stories.label: India · Land & livelihood
stories.head: Contempt plea against tribal families
bullets: The state says the families set up camps in a tiger reserve.
A 2025 High Court order told both sides to keep the status quo.
A community group calls the move "bureaucratic highhandedness".
